Walk-In-Interview
Walk-In-Interview for the post of Assistant Professor as Guest Faculty for
following subjects will be conducted on 18.01.2024 (Thursday) at Rajiv Gandhi
College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Subject Nos of Vacancy Time of Interview
English 01 11:00 AM
Physical Education 01 01:00 PM
Salary: As per UGC/Panjab University/Punjab Govt. Regulation
Qualifications: as per Panjab University/UGC norms.
Important instructions:
1. Interested candidates are advised to download application proforma
from P.U. website, filled and affix one latest passport size colour
photograph, attached one set of photocopy of all documents (self
attested) and bring on the interview venue.
2. Application proforma for Direct recruitment of Assistant Professor (As
per UGC Regulation 2018) can be downloaded from Panjab University
Jobs site:
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.
3. On the interview date candidates are advised to carry all original
documents for verification.
4. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing interview.
Sd/-
Principal
